sloka: इत्येवं परुषं वाक्यं ब्रुवाणे हरिपुङ्गवे ।अमर्षवशमापन्नो निशाचरगणेश्वरः ।। ६.४१.८१ ।।।।
transliteration: ityevaṁ paruṣaṁ vākyaṁ bruvāṇe haripuṅgave ।amarṣavaśamāpanno niśācaragaṇeśvaraḥ ।। 6.41.81 ।।।।

translations.english: "You are an enemy of the gods, Danavas and Yakshas, Gandharvas and Nagas and being a thorn in the neck of sages, I will uproot you from here."
